history.name: A whole new area is announced once
history.description: When an entire sub-section arrives in one release, its heading carries the mark and the entries inside it stay plain. A column of identical New tags says nothing the heading hasn't already said, and it would drown out the one genuinely changed entry in the release after.
history.dev_notes: MarkdownRenderer#allNew() decides this; the PDF does the same thing by drawing one green card.
